File No. CRA26-24444
East Tampa - 34th St. Workforce Housing - Williams Brown Legacy Project- This project is a mixed-use affordable housing development that will be located along the 34th Street corridor within the East Tampa CRA. The project will produce 31 affordable rental housing units serving households earning 30%, 50%, and 80% of Area Median Income (AMI), and includes ground-floor commercial space designed to support community-serving retail, specifically focused on promoting health, access to affordable food options, and neighborhood services for East Tampa residents. This component is intended to address long-standing community concerns regarding access to healthy food and neighborhood retail amenities.

Memorandum from Belix Parks, CRA Community Development Coordinator, transmitting a written report for said agenda item. (To be R/F)

Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the city of Tampa, Florida, approving and authorizing the Chair or Chair Pro-tem of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa to execute a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding by, between and among the City of Tampa, the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, Hillsborough County, Rays Baseball Club, LLC, and Tampa Bay Rays Stadium Company, LLC, concerning the development construction, funding, ownership and operation of a new ballpark project for the purpose of hosting major league baseball games by the Tampa Bay Rays and for other community events on a portion of the current campus and property of Hillsborough College located at the intersection of Dale Mabry Highway and Tampa Bay Boulevard in the Drew Park Community Redevelopment area, and providing certain terms and conditions for the negotiation of more detailed project agreements for the development, construction, funding, ownership and operation of said new ballpark project; providing an effective date. (Continued from May 21, 2026)

Memorandum from Board member Clendenin, requesting that said agenda item be continued to July 23, 2026. (To be R/F)
